image_description: A close-up, cropped view of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor). The image focuses on the anterior and mid-section of the fish, showing the characteristic black head and front body transitioning into a bright yellow posterior. A small portion of the eye is visible on the far left edge. The background is a blurred blue-grey, indicative of an underwater environment.
